title: ScheduleFindArguments
description: The arguments of the `schedule_find` tool (`pipeshub@schedules/find`, ADR-SCH-03 D2): a read of the caller's own schedules, at most 20, this chat's first and then the next to run. `query` matches the name (case-insensitive, a substring); `madeHere` keeps the ones this chat made. It changes nothing, so it asks nothing. The same filters are `GET /api/v1/agent-harness/schedules` `query`, `status` and `conversationId`.

query.description: Words of the schedule's name; not only spaces.

madeHere.description: Only the schedules this chat made.
